reason: labC on these two batches read a packet containing the pocket envelope block, while labA and labB on the same batches read the pre-envelope packet. Cause: the batch files were rebuilt with the envelope while this labelling run was mid-flight, and restored to pre-envelope ~2 minutes later. Two of 15 running agents fell in that window.
impact: within these two batches the three labellers did not read the same evidence, so the chair adjudicates readings from two packet versions, and labC may cite residues the chair's own packet does not contain.
fix: after wf_e9c1c64f-d58 completes, re-run batches 0024 and 0025 (3 labellers + chair each, 8 agents, ~40 min) against the restored pre-envelope packet so the whole g2 generation is one evidence version.
detected_by: grep -l 'pocket envelope -- REACHABLE SPACE' on the workflow's agent transcripts
do_not_mix: these two batches are g2; batches 0041+ are g3 and keep the envelope
